description: RiskInfo Sri Lanka (National Disaster Risk Information Platform) is a data portal run by Disaster Management Centre of Sri Lanka, with the World Bank OpenDRI programme. RiskInfo is a GeoNode-based open geospatial platform with a public API that listed 19 layers when read, among them boundaries and hazard and exposure layers, following its launch in 2017 with nationwide flood, landslide and drought impact maps. Coverage: Sri Lanka. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as wms, shp, geojson; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("GeoNode") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support hazard exposure studies of Sri Lankan infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
